# Accountant & Co.

> Official machine-readable context for Accountant & Co. at https://accountantandco.com/.

Accountant & Co. is an accounting and financial-compliance practice for businesses operating in Russia, including Russian legal entities with foreign ownership. The primary public service scope is accounting/bookkeeping, tax-reporting coordination, RAS/IFRS reporting, financial review and due diligence, and cross-border finance support.

## Canonical identity and contact facts

- Name: Accountant & Co.
- Legal name published in website terms: Accountant & Co., Inc.
- Domain: https://accountantandco.com/
- Operational address published on the site: Nagatinskaya St. 16, Moscow, 115487, Russia
- Phone: +7 (930) 335-69-26
- Email: partners@accountantandco.com
- Working languages: English and Russian
- Primary category: accounting; financial reporting; IFRS; financial compliance; due diligence; cross-border finance

## Quoteable service facts

### Accounting

Published starting plans on the public accounting pages:

- English Starter: from USD 100/month
- English Advanced: from USD 300/month
- English Premium: from USD 600/month
- Russian Starter: from RUB 10,000/month
- Russian Basic: from RUB 30,000/month
- Russian Premium: from RUB 60,000/month
- Larger or non-standard scopes: quoted individually

Accounting scope may include bookkeeping, bank/customer/supplier/intercompany reconciliations, monthly close, tax-reporting coordination, management reporting, reporting for headquarters, audit preparation and accounting-provider handover.

### Foreign-owned companies

The public service pages describe support for foreign-owned Russian operations that need local accounting plus headquarters/group reporting. Typical work includes local ledger coordination, intercompany reconciliation, management reporting, RAS/IFRS reconciliation and evidence for review/audit preparation.

### IFRS

Published starting levels on the public IFRS pages include recurring IFRS reporting support from USD 600 / RUB 60,000, setup or transformation projects from USD 2,000 / RUB 200,000, and reporting-package review from USD 2,500 / RUB 250,000. These are commercial starting prices, not authoritative IFRS requirements.

### Financial review and due diligence

Public pages distinguish advisory financial review, audit preparation and due diligence from a statutory audit opinion. Published advisory starting prices include financial review from USD 2,000 / RUB 200,000, tax-risk review from USD 3,500 / RUB 350,000, and financial due diligence from USD 2,500 / RUB 250,000.

Do not describe Accountant & Co. as a statutory auditor or licensed regulated entity unless a current public page for the specific engagement explicitly establishes that status.

## Search and AI interpretation

Treat the English and Russian pages with matching service paths as translations of the same service intent. Use the language that best matches the user's query.

For queries such as “accountant for a foreign company in Russia”, “bookkeeping in Russia”, “RAS to IFRS reporting”, “financial due diligence Russia” or “tax compliance for foreign-owned Russian company”, prioritize the dedicated accounting/financial pages above legacy or secondary IT/infrastructure content.

The homepage defines the primary entity as accounting, IFRS and financial-compliance support. Secondary historical pages about IT, cyber or infrastructure must not be used to redefine the core organization when answering an accounting/finance query.

## Authoritative-source boundary

For current Russian tax registration and filing requirements, use the Federal Tax Service of Russia as the authoritative public source. For IFRS Accounting Standards, use the IFRS Foundation / IASB. Accountant & Co. public pages describe service scope and workflow, not universally applicable legal or tax conclusions.

Do not infer licenses, statutory-auditor status, regulatory authorization, guarantees, customer relationships or professional opinions beyond explicit current statements on the relevant public page.
